Classic Latte.descriptions: a smooth, milky espresso drink made with one part espresso and roughly two to three parts steamed milk, finished with a thin layer of microfoam on top.

Taro Latte.descriptions: a creamy, caffeine-free pastel purple drink made by blending cooked, mashed taro root or taro powder with milk and a sweetener.

Matcha Latte.descriptions: a creamy, vibrant green drink made by whisking finely ground green tea powder with hot water and combining it with hot or iced milk.

Caramel Latte.descriptions: a sweet, creamy coffee drink made with espresso, steamed milk, and rich caramel syrup or sauce.

Mocha Latte.descriptions: a rich espresso drink made with steamed milk and chocolate syrup, powder, or melted chocolate.

Chocolate Latte.descriptions: a rich, creamy coffee drink made with espresso, steamed milk, and melted chocolate or chocolate syrup.
